create_IndexFlatL2_quantizer: create a flat L2 quantizer for a given vector dimension using faiss.IndexFlatL2
create_IndexIVFPQ_index: create an IVFPQ index with product quantization encoding sub-vectors as 8 bits
train_IVFPQ_index: train the IVFPQ index on a database of random float32 vectors
add_vectors_to_index: add database vectors to the trained IVFPQ index for indexing
search_IVFPQ_index: search the IVFPQ index for k nearest neighbors of query vectors
